recipe:
# lc runs recipes as `bash -c` with no `set -e`, so without this a failed
# compute would exit 0 via the trailing `rm` and lc would commit a
# truncated artifact as successfully produced.
set -e
x=$(mktemp -d) && tar xzf results/submitted/two_point/xi_scan/xi_sweep_bundle.tar.gz -C $x
c=$(mktemp -d) && tar xzf results/submitted/covariance/cov_scan/cov_sweep_bundle.tar.gz -C $c
l=$(mktemp -d) && tar xzf results/submitted/cl_bb/cl_scan/cl_sweep_bundle.tar.gz -C $l
# NB: braced shell expansions cannot be used in a sweep template — the
# expander claims that syntax. Bare $cb only.
ver=$(python src/papers/bmodes/scripts/paper_config.py --config results/submitted/catalog/selected_config.yaml --scan-version SP_v1.4.8_leak_corr --fine-grid)
cb=covariance_"$ver"_A_integration
nb=$(printf '%s' bins_96 | tr -cd '0-9')
python src/papers/bmodes/scripts/harmonic_config_cosebis_comparison.py \
  --config results/submitted/catalog/selected_config.yaml \
  --blind A \
  --fiducial-version $ver \
  --harmonic-validation-binning bins_96 \
  --fiducial-pseudo-cl-path "$l/pseudo_cl_$ver"_blind=A_powspace_nbins=$nb.fits \
  --fiducial-pseudo-cl-cov-path "$l/pseudo_cl_cov_$ver"_blind=A_powspace_nbins=$nb.fits \
  --fiducial-xi-path "$x/$ver"_xi_minsep=0.5_maxsep=300.0_nbins=1000_npatch=1.txt \
  --fiducial-cov-path "$c/$cb/$cb"_processed.txt \
  --scale-cut-convention grid_bin_edges \
  --out-file results/submitted/cosebis/cosebis_harmonic_scan/harmonic_modes_sp_v1p4p8.npz
rm -rf "$x" "$c" "$l"
